# ChannelPayload.timestamp property

When the change occurred. Arrives JSON-encoded and is revived into a `Date` before a [ChannelPayloadFilter](/api/pg-cache/latest/pg-cache.channelpayloadfilter/) sees it.

**Signature:**

```typescript
timestamp: Date;
```
